why: The intersection volumes in compact-reference.json are Rhino outputs built at model tolerance 0.001. On curved families they are not accurate enough to gate a kernel at 1e-6: Rhino's own union plus intersection misses the sum of its inputs by 0.00215 on Torus and 0.00834 on Cones, recorded there as volume_identity_diagnostics, far above its reported integration error. The operands are exact rational tori and cones, so the true volume can be computed. Rhino's values stay in compact-reference.json, still drive the checks of Rhino's own consistency, and restore the old gate if this file is removed from the test.

methods.truth.py: Divergence theorem over each operand's boundary inside the other, exact cuts per parameter line, tanh-sinh outer integral. The total must not depend on the flux origin; two origins agree to 1.2e-9 on Torus and 9e-13 on Cones.
methods.truth_check.py: Independent: parallel rays along a generic direction, exact inside length from a quartic or quadratic, summed over a random-shift grid, with its own STEP reading. The error bar is 2 std / sqrt(shifts). Reproduces the sphere lens, Steinmetz solid and each operand with itself within the bar at 2048 x 2048, 16 shifts.
